title: C2 Milestone 10
completion_message: ¡Formidable! Has superado el Milestone 10. Las cláusulas de participio, la jerga contable, las tácticas de negociación y los modismos ejecutivos te colocan en el nivel más alto de comunicación internacional. ¡La mitad de tu viaje por C2 está cumplida!

parts.visual:
Este Milestone evalúa tu dominio en la alta dirección: 

1. Participle Clauses: 
- KNOWING the truth... (Sabiendo...) 
- MADE in China... (Hecho en...) 
- HAVING FINISHED... (Habiendo terminado...) 

2. Corporate Finance: 
- ROI (Return on Investment). 
- EBITDA (Operational profitability). 
- Balance sheet (Assets, Liabilities). 
- Cash flow & The bottom line.
parts.audio: Welcome to Milestone 10, Executive Acumen. This exam tests your highest-level corporate skills. First, Participle Clauses for efficiency. Phrases like: KNOWING the truth... MADE in China... and HAVING FINISHED. Second, Corporate Finance. Mastering terms like ROI, EBITDA, Balance sheet, Cash flow, Assets, Liabilities, and The bottom line.

parts.visual:
3. Negotiation Strategies: 
- Leverage (Poder de negociación). 
- Compromise (Ceder/Punto medio). 
- Dealbreaker (Rompe-tratos). 
- Play hardball & Stalemate. 

4. Success & Failure Idioms: 
- Hit it out of the park (Éxito rotundo). 
- Ahead of the curve. 
- Go down in flames. 
- Back to the drawing board.
parts.audio: Third, Negotiation Strategies. Knowing how to use your Leverage, when to Compromise or meet halfway, identifying a Dealbreaker, and navigating a Stalemate when people play hardball. Finally, Success and Failure Idioms. Knowing when someone hits it out of the park, is ahead of the curve, goes down in flames, or needs to go back to the drawing board. Good luck!

stages.title: The Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu agudeza financiera y retórica en este examen de consolidación.

questions.question: Normal: Because he had read the report, he knew what to do. -> Participle: ____ the report, he knew what to do.
To understand the company's true operational profitability before taxes, we must look at the ____.
questions.explanation: EBITDA = Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization.

questions.question: Since we are the only supplier of this microchip, we have all the ____ in the negotiation. (Ventaja/Poder).
The marketing campaign was a massive success. They really hit it out of the ____.
questions.explanation: Hit it out of the park.

questions.question: Normal: If it is handled properly, this situation will be fine. -> Participle: ____ properly, this situation will be fine.
The money a company owes to the bank and its suppliers is listed as ____ on the balance sheet.
We want a 10% discount, they offer 0%. Let's ____ halfway at 5%.
If you fail this inspection, the factory will be closed. This is a recipe for ____.
Normal: Not wanting to be late, he took a taxi. -> Participle: ____ to be late, he took a taxi.
Even though our P&L looks great, our clients aren't paying us on time, so we have a ____ flow problem.
The peace talks have reached a ____; neither side is willing to change their position.
The launch was terrible. We have to scrap everything and go back to the ____ board.
Normal: Driven by fear, the investors sold all their stock. -> Participle: ____ by fear, the investors sold...
Rent and basic utility bills are fixed costs, also known as ____. (Gastos fijos operacionales).
We both had to make concessions to reach an agreement. We had to ____. (Llegar a un punto medio).
The company is bleeding money every day. It's time to cancel the project and ____ our losses.
In finance, the absolute final net profit line of the P&L statement is called the ____ line.
Refusing to work from home is an absolute ____ for me. I won't accept the job. (Condición que rompe el trato).
Normal: As she walked out the door, she shouted at the receptionist. -> Participle: She walked out the door, ____ at the receptionist.
We survived the crisis. We managed to ____ the storm.
____ the truth... (Sabiendo con K)
____ read the book... (Habiendo con H)
____ in China. (Hecho con M)
Things you owe. (Pasivos con L)
The ____ line. (Ganancia neta final con B)
We have the ____. (Poder/Ventaja de negociación con L)
We had to ____. (Ceder para llegar a acuerdo con C)
A complete ____. (Punto muerto con S)
Hit it out of the ____. (Éxito rotundo con P)
____ our losses. (Cortar las pérdidas con C)
